children: European stock indexes hands back earlier gains as a global stock market selloff gathers pace. Tech stocks drag benchmarks across the continent lower, while a rise in oil prices adds to downward pressure. The Stoxx 600 falls 0.2% after opening in the green, with a basket of European tech stocks dropping 2%. The German DAX is 0.5% lower. Chip maker Infineon loses 5.1%, while AI-linked Siemens Energy drops 2.4%. The semiconductor-dominated AEX falls 0.7% in Amsterdam, where ASML--Europe's most valuable company--sheds 3.4%. The Spanish IBEX 35 falls 0.8%, while the Italian FTSE MIB drops 1%. Some indexes remain in positive territory: London's FTSE 100 nudges up 0.1%, while a rally in European luxury stocks helps the CAC 40 to rise 0.4%. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
